title: api.v4.CreateDeploymentArtifactsBody
description: Deployment details, including artifacts and the environment they're deployed to

artifactReferences.description: The list of build artifacts to be linked to deployment that associate with the run.

environment.description: The environment in which the deployment artifacts are deployed (e.g., "production", "staging").

url.description: The url of the artifact. Must be an absolute URI (e.g. https://... or pkg:...).

type.description: The type of the artifact. Supported values: container, binary, helm, npm, maven, pypi, gem, nuget.

label.description: A comma-separated list of artifact labels.

repositoryUrl.description: Clone URL of the artifact repository.

ref.description: Branch name of checked out source repository.

stageName.description: The name of the stage in which the artifact is being created.

stageId.description: The unique identifier of the stage in which the artifact is being created.

artifactId.description: The Artifact Id for registering the deployment

api.v4.ArtifactInfo.description: ArtifactInfo represents a build artifact to associate with a run.
